moves.method: git mv, then extract the other features

checks: start: the demo vault's home renders; ctrl+q quits cleanly
diagrams: background layout arrives, an external edit replaces it, and navigation still works
diagrams: a pending drawing labels its source until the bounded attempt settles
tables: a wide table fits the window, every row closed by its right border
code blocks and properties: the frontmatter drawn as properties, a fence labelled with its language
code blocks: a tree too wide scrolls sideways on its own — find, $ and 0, a sideways wheel, shift and the wheel; the UI settings wrap it instead
width: names in their own scripts — Japanese, Arabic, an emoji — in a table below the embeds
embeds: a whole note and a heading's section drawn in place; a link in one followed from where it is
footnotes: space n f opens the right panel's second view, its button under ▤; enter jumps to a reference; space n shift+f adds one; :footnotes toggles
hostile names: a bidi override, C1, ESC and an OSC in file names never reach the terminal
big notes: a 2 MB note parsed on other threads, then drawn; its end and back at once; re-wrapped at another width, still at its end (15.1)
big notes: a file over walk.max_file_size listed as skipped in the vault's info, never searched
tables: kestrel's torture note and a training log — every table lines up, page after page, to the end
hostile text: escapes in a note, a log, JSON values and a fixture never reach the terminal — no title set, no screen cleared
width: wide characters line up — CJK, fullwidth, emoji, flags, combining, Thai, Devanagari, Arabic: tables' borders in one column; l steps a character
unicode: Japanese in source mode — w, b and e a character each, ciw the whole run, typed and saved
odd files: /dev/zero by a symlink and an unreadable note refused, said; a symlink out of the root never opened; the vault's info says why each was left out
odd files: a symlinked note edited and saved — written through to its target, still a symlink
line endings: a BOM before the frontmatter, CRLF and lone CRs drawn without stray cells; a save keeps the BOM and every CRLF
data: TOML — keys lined up, a comment after its value, records as a table; a value's path followed and back
data: the lens edits one key of a TOML file on its own line; space n v shows the source
data: CSV as a table — a quoted field with doubled quotes; past 2,000 rows counted, source mode has every line
data: YAML — records as a table; nested maps a tree with guides at every depth, the breadcrumb following
data: JSON — a $ref's pointer followed to the row it names; INI keys lined up, a comment after its value
data: a file that doesn't parse opens in source mode, said why — JSON and TOML alike
data: Java's .properties — ! comments are comments, a value continued after a backslash one value; multi-document YAML a row each
data: an .env — export prefixes dropped, a quoted value unquoted, its comment after it
data: JSON with comments and trailing commas renders; a 3,000-line lock file's end at once; 290 KB on one line a tree to its last entry
code: Python's outline from its grammar, the breadcrumb inside a method; a comment's path:line followed and back
code: TypeScript's breadcrumb from its grammar; a comment's relative path followed
code: a syntax error counted on the status line, hidden while typing, back after
code: Go, Rust, Lua, shell, JavaScript and TSX — each outline from its grammar, the breadcrumb two levels in
code: syntax errors in TypeScript and Go counted on the status line, no server
code: a 4,000-line TypeScript file — its outline found, G at its end, keys answered at once
code view: a comment's prose drawn as text, its path a link enter follows
code view: a syntax error slipbox finds itself, no server — counted, and on its cell's header alone
obsidian: a ==highlight== drawn in its own colour, %%comments%% hidden while reading; both as typed in source mode
info: the Info view — the file's root, properties, backlinks and tags; toggled from the palette
properties: space n shift+p edits the frontmatter's YAML in a floating editor, written back, the Info view updated
info: the vault's info in its own window; reindex said; the config reloaded; messages; help
trust: a project whose own code its tools would run — asked once; y kept across a start; :untrust takes it back (23.x)
privacy: a root's config can't set images_remote or update.check — each warned of, ignored; its web picture asked about, not fetched (DF-D1, DF-D23)
headings: six levels, each its colour and band; setext's two as ATX's; a heading longer than its row wraps, its band on every row
lists: bullets by depth, numbers lined up past 9, tasks ticked or not; an item's code, table and quote hang under it
quotes and callouts: a quote's bar, nested deeper; each callout its icon and title, its list and code inside; lookalikes stay quotes
paragraphs, rules and HTML: soft breaks join, each kind of hard break breaks; --- a rule; HTML document content rendered; each comment hidden, inline HTML formatted
wrapping: a narrow terminal wraps prose at its spaces, no row past its edge; a no-break space keeps a number with its unit
themes: space u t lists the built-ins and your own, each previewed as the list moves; esc goes back, enter keeps one; :theme names one
colors: [colors] overrides a role in every theme, [colors.nord] under nord alone
glyphs: space u g previews each set; :glyphs ascii draws bullets, boxes, bars, headings and tables in ASCII; unicode again
status line: the mode, the file, its problems, words, the cursor's line and column and how far down; unsaved said; a selection's words; the vault on the top bar, not here
headings: space n h renames the heading the cursor is in — a preview of each link to it, enter, every link rewritten
document types: space f d lists them with their notes; :type adr the ADRs in order, each its status; ] t and [ t step through them
code: beyond the grammars — Java in source mode, no outline; a Dockerfile's stages its outline; a Vue component's parts, each with its definitions
code cells: z a folds one to its header and opens it again; space k y copies its lines, space k s adds it to the scratch, space k e edits it in the lens, space k p its problems
code cells: space k r — where the cell's definition is used, from TypeScript's own server
samples: the agent replay script edits a folder while it's shown — its note comes and goes in the explorer, the plan beside it untouched

invariants: All 57 check names, assertions, options, setup/cleanup and deadlines unchanged
All ordered registrations, areas, coverage and left-out reasons unchanged
No product source or fixture changes
retained_references: Historical ORG inventory and original-scope task paths remain evidence, not runtime references
